template_data.lead_html: He had 12 years in business and one question that changed how I explain everything.

rows.what_html: "Do we still bid on every contract?" — No. The Schedule changes that equation.
Pre-negotiated pricing. Pre-approved qualifications. — Agencies can buy directly from you.
The Schedule removes friction before the race — not during it.

template_data.closer: BEING LISTED IS EARNING THE RIGHT TO BE BOUGHT.
